== Summary ==
Sta Trek CCG finalist Sean Wiedemann of Ithaca, New York is the pride of Cornell U. Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999#Star Trek CCG World Championship|Star Trek CCG at DecipherCon 1999]] and [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]].
